primary_mechanistic_endpoint: Mean fractional weight attenuation d on initially majority-correct stuff candidates; GT purity>=0.5 fixed a priori
secondary_mechanistic_endpoints: Fraction of such candidates with any d>0
Analytical normalized candidate coefficient changes under the full episode denominator; not gradient/loss mass
D_self-D_class_union after weakening all source-predicted same-real-class locations
GT same-class area outside the candidate; stratified by its presence, not selected using outcomes
adaptation_endpoints: GT-role-specific actual pixel Correct-to-Wrong and Wrong-to-Correct
fixed-candidate GT accuracy before/after; averaged within image, not token-level pseudo-replication
profiling: First 4 episodes, fixed candidates, native diagnostic-view evaluation only; 3 repeats per policy, alternating policy order. Separate from actual adaptation outcomes; exclude initialization, source logits, loading and scoring.
population: Fixed seed-selected 64-image validation diagnostic panels, no selection/tuning after scoring
statistical_scope: Descriptive paired mechanism/control effects; no significance asserted from rounded mIoU, seeds, pixels or candidates
labels: No labels in view construction, weighting or optimization. All predictions/candidates sealed before separate GT scoring.
scheduling: Appended after original suite and representative backbone; no existing queue interrupted or reordered
union_control: All source argmax tokens of the same REAL class within the same crop, valid pixels only, plus candidate; no GT masks
interpretation: Role exemption is not presumed to improve mIoU. Mechanism and end-to-end allocation effects reported separately.
